summary: Phase 3 backend + frontend testing complete. All 24 backend pytest tests pass (Participants CRUD, Accommodation participant beds with 409 duplicate & capacity checks, Transport drivers/vehicles/assignments incl. driver_name & 404 validations, public team portal reflecting transport). Frontend UI verified end-to-end for Participants (add via dialog / team filter), Accommodation (mode-participant toggle -> team+participant+room -> assign -> row shows participant name -> delete), Transport (add driver, vehicle, assignment; public /teams/1 shows TEST_UI_BUS), and QR (public team-qr-btn opens qr-dialog with qr-svg + print-qr-btn; admin qr-team-1 opens dialog with URL /teams/1).
critical_code_review_comments: Transport router: creating a vehicle with driver_id=0 silently skips 404 check (falsy short-circuit) — acceptable since ids start at 1 but consider `is not None`.

Accommodation capacity guard counts every assignment row (team + participants) as 1 bed, per spec; if a team was assigned as a whole then participants are added to same room, they collectively count against capacity — worth documenting in UI.
Public /api/public/teams/{id} exposes participant full_name & role; ensure that aligns with privacy expectations (currently intentional per portal design).
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up during tests: TEST_P3_* participants/drivers/vehicles/assignments; TEST_UI_Bob participant (deleted via API); TEST_UI_Driver + TEST_UI_BUS + assignment (deleted via API).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 fully green. All new data-testids present. Native <select> elements used — playwright select_option works. QR renders via qrcode.react (SVG element with data-testid=qr-svg). Dialog handlers for confirm() prompts must be attached BEFORE click; UI delete for participants uses confirm() — I attached it before but earlier attempt failed; API cleanup was used to guarantee no leftover TEST_ rows.
